title: Bare rule mcp__homelab auto-allows every tool of server homelab-kb (string-prefix match), including its delete/ingest tools
observed: kiln defect. Steps: scratch HOME with Andre's ~/.claude/settings.json (allow list has bare 'mcp__homelab', no homelab-kb rule); kiln --permission-mode acceptEdits on Opus; ask a question that needs the homelab-kb MCP. mcp__homelab-kb__hk_search ran with no prompt (log 16:00:52 tool_start, no permission prompt on screen). Cause: internal/claude/settings/settings.go:341 MatchesRule returns strings.HasPrefix(tool, bare) for a bare mcp__ rule, so 'mcp__homelab' also covers server 'homelab-kb', including hk_delete_entry and hk_ingest_entry (live writes). The same prefix logic makes an exact tool rule such as 'mcp__pocket-id__user_get' cover any longer tool name with that prefix. Not exercised destructively (read-only rule kept).
expected: Claude Code (src/utils/permissions/permissions.ts toolMatchesRule) parses the rule with mcpInfoFromString and requires ruleInfo.serverName === toolInfo.serverName (the tool part must be absent or '*'); a full tool rule matches only that exact name. mcp__homelab should match only server 'homelab', so homelab-kb tools should prompt in acceptEdits.

fix.note: b66380a on branch worktree-agent-ae1e528c60b007fe6 (not merged; unit tests only, no real-terminal re-drive)
